samir: Quick flag . Mingling-v1 int4 canary shows token-boundary drift for ideographic space (U+3000), narrow no-break space (U+202F), and RTL isolate markers. Small sample attached.
hana: Paste one?
samir: zh snippet: 
```
src: 
ref: 
pre-quant detok: 
post-quant detok: 
```
(weird rendering above but gist: U+3000 collapsed and two han merged after quant)
pablo: also saw ja ruby/furigana collapse where U+202F moves into the following token after q4 compaction.
mei: any RTL repro?
samir: ar example: parentheses mirror attaches to previous token -> bracket/paren now glued.
ops-bot: Canary job `mingling-int4-canary` alerted: 6/150 samples regressed. Auto-promote paused.
hana: initial hypothesis: compacting pass in int4 path is reordering low-frequency sentinel tokens; qgather vector reorder touched codepoint-stable ordering.
pablo: plan: (1) add focused smoke tests for U+3000/U+202F/U+200D/U+200C/U+2066-9, (2) bisect qgather/compaction commits, (3) pause int4 promote until fix.
mei: I'll add the smoke tests and a tiny SRT subset with annotated ruby/ideospace/nnbsp cases.
hana: I'll run bisect on qgather range and start a micro-repro harness to dump token ids before/after embedding remap.
samir: tagging followups: @mei tests, @hana bisect, @pablo prepare canary mini-corpus.
ops-bot: Auto-promote remains paused for `mingling-v1` quant pipelines (thread 3309991234).
mei: I'll open a PR with failing sample once bisect points to a commit.
hana: If kernel reorder is culprit, we can fallback to stable gather for nominated codepoints as interim.
samir: thanks team . Will re-run canary after patching.
